verdict.rationale: Receipt issuance is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never documents printed or email/SMS receipts, or compliance with card-network receipt requirements. The only receipt mention is 'Tipping on the receipt', which belongs to the tipping story and does not show receipt generation.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue digital (email/SMS) or printed receipts that meet card-network requirements
